description: This file defines the Snapshotter class used for capturing and managing page frame snapshots within the Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for starting, resetting, stopping, and capturing snapshots, as well as handling frame hierarchy annotations.

classes.name: Snapshotter
classes.description: Manages page snapshot capturing, frame hierarchy annotation, and snapshot lifecycle within a browser context.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes the snapshotter and begins snapshot capturing.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the snapshotter state across all frames.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the snapshotter from capturing further snapshots.

methods.name: resetForReuse
methods.description: Prepares the snapshotter for reuse by disposing of scripts and event listeners.

methods.name: _initialize
methods.description: Sets up the snapshotter, including injecting scripts into pages.

methods.name: dispose
methods.description: Cleans up event listeners and resources.

methods.name: _captureFrameSnapshot
methods.description: Captures a snapshot of a specific frame.

methods.name: captureSnapshot
methods.description: Captures snapshots for all frames in a page and delegates the results.

methods.name: _onPage
methods.description: Handles new page events to set up frame hierarchy annotation.

methods.name: _annotateFrameHierarchy
methods.description: Annotates frame hierarchy for snapshot purposes.
